why: ladder.scripted_opponents (db9daa4) against its parent 35d9d33, plain arm on RustEngine (past the opening lockout). db9daa4 adds one config field, LadderConfig.scripted_opponents, whose default is the two anchors, and passes it to MixMatchmaker. With the default nothing a run does changes, so the only differences are the new key in config.json and what hashes the config: the config hashes, the identity's ladder_digest (it digests the whole ladder block), the run_id derived from the identity, and the manifest's copies of config_hash and run_id in both checkpoints. The engine binary, weights, moments, state digests, every metric key and value, the alarm table, its parameters and firings, every other checkpoint leaf and every checkpoint file sha are equal. Measured 2026-09-25 11:42-11:43 (PDT) with RoyaleGym 9b20372 pinned on both sides, RoyaleSim 1b950ea, royalesim.pyd 3d062d96a96c.
